description: This source file contains implementation of network connectivity monitoring and caching functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes classes and methods for loading configuration, checking internet connectivity via cURL, managing endpoint cache files, and handling continuous and initial connectivity monitoring threads.

classes.name: EndpointCache
classes.description: Manages reading and writing of connectivity endpoint cache files, including existence check, reading list of endpoints, and writing endpoints to file.

classes.name: Connectivity
classes.description: Provides methods for testing network connectivity through HTTP requests using libcurl, including response analysis to determine internet state.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Handles monitoring the internet connectivity status, manages worker threads for periodic checks, and maintains endpoint configurations.

methods.name: loadConnectivityConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration parameters from a specified file, including endpoints, monitor interval, and enable flags.

methods.name: isConnectivityMonitorEndpointSet
methods.description: Checks if endpoints for connectivity monitoring are configured either in memory or from cache file.

methods.name: getInternetConnectionState
methods.description: Determines the current internet connection state, optionally using cache if monitor thread is active.

methods.name: testConnectivity
methods.description: Performs connectivity tests by sending HTTP requests to specified endpoints with curl, analyzing responses to determine internet status.

methods.name: checkInternetStateFromResponseCode
methods.description: Analyzes HTTP response codes from connectivity checks, returning the overall internet connectivity state based on response frequency.

methods.name: doContinuousConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Starts thread-based continuous monitoring of network connectivity at specified intervals.

methods.name: doInitialConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Performs a one-time initial connectivity check, potentially starting monitoring thread.

methods.name: stopInitialConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Stops the initial connectivity monitor thread if running.

methods.name: signalConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Signals the monitoring thread to restart the check cycle.

methods.name: connectivityMonitorFunction
methods.description: Main thread Routine for periodic connectivity checks and status updates.
